title: 第21章 玉衡上门请罪争夺宗主之位第22章 灵儿身世惨师父查身体
lines: 师徒三人回到住所，此刻院落已经大变样，原本杂草丛生，灰尘遍布的院落，已经被打扫的干干净净。
现在杂役弟子们正在打扫房间。
见玉龙上人回来，一个皮肤有些黑的年轻男子走了过来。
弯腰行礼道：“玉龙师叔，您的院舍马上就清理完毕，您看要不要留下两个杂役，伺候师叔的饮食起居。”
本来玉龙上人是要挑选两个机灵的小丫头，毕竟自已的闺女年纪已经不小，既然带回来了，肯定要传她功法，总不能让自已的宝贝女儿浪费时间在洗衣做饭上吧，饮食起居方面确实需要人照顾。
不过，在得知叶风被人加害，埋在乱坟岗后，玉龙上人便改变了主意。
他可不想让人在自已的身边安两个眼线。
于是摆手道：“我这辈子闲散惯了，就怕别人伺候，这事儿等过段时间再说吧。”
那位年轻弟子微微点头，道：“嗯，如果师叔需要杂役，尽可以前去外门挑选。”
不多时，几个房间，厨房，小饭堂全部打扫干净。
这些外门弟子干活很仔细，就连床底都被打扫的一尘不染。
之所以这么卖力，主要是想给玉龙上人留下个好印象。
他们这些外门杂役弟子，地位是很低的，如果能被某位长老看中，留下负责照顾长老生活，那么他们的地位就会瞬间提高不少。
根据数据统计，这些贴身照顾长老的外门杂役弟子，有至少四成的概率，会被长老收为弟子。
这样他们就可以一飞冲天，成为内门精英弟子。
房间刚打扫完毕，玉龙上人正要关门询问叶风被埋乱坟岗的事儿。
忽然好多人来到了院外，为首的竟然是兽灵院的首席大长老玉衡上人。
身后跟随着不少弟子，挑着许多柴米油盐，鸡鸭鱼肉等生活物资。
消失三年的玉龙上人，带着失散多年的女儿回山，已经过去半日时间，此消息早已经传遍了星罗峰。
还有消息说，玉龙上人因为大弟子叶风被兽灵院派去看守药圃的事儿大发雷霆，扬言明天一早就去砸了兽灵院。
玉衡上人得知消息，很是紧张。
都是相识三四百年的老朋友，自然了解玉龙上人的脾性。
别人说要砸兽灵院，绝对是开玩笑。
玉龙上人说砸，多半是真的要砸的。
为避免事情闹大，玉衡上人便亲自过来了。
在云海六院中，规模最大，屁事最多，工作范围最广的，就是兽灵院。
兽灵院它更像是朝廷的户部。
可不仅仅是负责门中的灵兽，灵药。
还负责整个云海宗几万弟子的生活物资，什么瓜果蔬菜啊，鸡鸭鱼肉啊，物资采购啊，甚至云海宗在凡尘中的不少产业，都归他们管。
玉衡上人身高七尺，身材消瘦，道士发髻，虽然蓄着山羊胡，但胡子很稀疏。
由于很瘦，脸颊上的颧骨看起来有些突兀，眼眶内陷，但眼睛却是如电如鹰。
百十年前，便已经问鼎第八层天人境，现在至少也是天人巅峰境界。
content_en:
The three masters and apprentices returned to their residence. At this moment, the courtyard had changed drastically. The courtyard that was originally overgrown with weeds and dusty had been cleaned up.
Now the handyman disciples are cleaning the room.
Seeing Master Jade Dragon returning, a young man with somewhat dark skin walked over.
He bent down and saluted: "Uncle Yulong, your courtyard will be cleaned up soon. Do you want to leave two handymen to serve uncle's food and daily life?"
Originally, Master Jade Dragon wanted to choose two clever little girls. After all, his daughter is already quite old. Since she brought her back, she must teach her the skills. He can't let his precious daughter waste time on washing and cooking. She really needs someone to take care of her food and daily life.
However, after learning that Ye Feng was harmed and buried in a mass grave, Master Jade Dragon changed his mind.
He doesn't want people to put two eye spies around him.
So he waved his hand and said: "I've been used to being idle all my life, and I'm just afraid of being waited on by others. Let's wait until some time to discuss this matter."
The young disciple nodded slightly and said, "Well, if your uncle needs handymen, you can go to the outer sect to choose them."
Not long after, several rooms, the kitchen, and the small dining room were all cleaned.
These outer disciples work very carefully, even the bottom of the bed is cleaned spotlessly.
The reason why I work so hard is mainly to leave a good impression on Master Jade Dragon.
These outer sect servant disciples have a very low status. If they can be favored by an elder and stay in charge of taking care of the elder's life, then their status will instantly improve a lot.
According to statistics, these outer disciples who take care of the elders have at least a 40% chance of being accepted as disciples by the elders.
In this way, they can soar into the sky and become elite disciples of the inner sect.
The room had just been cleaned, and Master Yulong was about to close the door and ask about Ye Feng being buried in a mass grave.
Suddenly, many people came outside the courtyard, and the leader turned out to be the chief elder of the Beast Spirit Academy, Master Yu Heng.
There were many disciples following behind, carrying a lot of daily necessities such as firewood, rice, oil, salt, chicken, duck, fish and meat.
Master Jade Dragon, who had disappeared for three years, returned to the mountain with his long-lost daughter. Half a day had passed, and the news had already spread throughout Xingluo Peak.
There is also news that Master Yulong was furious because his eldest disciple Ye Feng was sent by the Beast Spirit Academy to guard the medicine garden, and threatened to destroy the Beast Spirit Academy early tomorrow morning.
Master Yuheng was very nervous when he heard the news.
They are all old friends who have known each other for three to four hundred years, so they naturally understand the temperament of Master Jade Dragon.
When others say they want to destroy the Beast Spirit Academy, they are definitely joking.
When Master Jade Dragon says it will be smashed, he probably really means smashing it.
In order to avoid making things worse, Master Yu Heng came over in person.
Among the six Yunhai Institutes, the one with the largest scale, the most troubles, and the widest scope of work is the Beast Spirit Institute.
The Beast Spirit Academy is more like the household department of the imperial court.
He is not only responsible for the spiritual beasts and elixirs in the door.
They are also responsible for the daily necessities of tens of thousands of disciples of the entire Yunhai Sect, such as fruits and vegetables, chickens, ducks, fish and meat, material procurement, and even many of the Yunhai Sect's industries in the mortal world are under their control.
Master Yuheng is seven feet tall, thin and has a Taoist bun. Although he has a goatee, it is very sparse.
Because he is very thin, the cheekbones on his cheeks look a bit abrupt, and his eye sockets are sunken, but his eyes are as electric as an eagle.
A hundred years ago, he had already reached the eighth level of Heaven and Human Realm, and now he is at least at the peak of Heaven and Human Realm.
title_en: Chapter 21 Yu Heng comes to plead guilty and competes for the position of the clan leader Chapter 22 Ling'er's life experience is tragic and the master checks his body
